name: Choka Tremolo
dimensionsSource: TC Electronic product page and Quick Start Guide (58 H x 74 W x 132 D mm)

jacks.label: INPUT
jacks.note: 1/4-inch TS unbalanced; 500 kΩ input impedance. Position estimated from the official rear/top views: INPUT is on the player's right (top edge ~0.8).

jacks.label: OUTPUT
jacks.note: 1/4-inch TS unbalanced; 1 kΩ output impedance. Position estimated from the official rear/top views: OUTPUT is on the player's left (top edge ~0.2).

jacks.label: 9V DC
jacks.note: Standard 9 V DC center-negative input, 5.5 x 2.1 mm; internal 9 V battery option. Centered on the top edge (~0.5); not a cable anchor.

power.note: Power input rated standard 9 V DC, center negative, >100 mA; current consumption 10 mA; internal 9 V battery connector.

io.note: One 1/4-inch TS unbalanced input and one 1/4-inch TS unbalanced output.

audio.note: Mono in/out, unbuffered TS jacks; no effects loop, headphones or DI.

control.note: Speed, Depth and LFO knobs plus one on/bypass footswitch; LED shows effect on.

circuit.note: All-analog circuitry; true bypass when disengaged.

physical.note: 58 x 74 x 132 mm (H x W x D); 0.5 kg; metal chassis; orange finish; top-mounted I/O.

optional.note: Optional facts captured during the same official product-page and Quick Start Guide pass.

notes: Vintage-flavored all-analog tremolo with Speed, Depth and LFO controls; the LFO knob morphs between triangle and square waveforms. True bypass with top-mounted I/O.

extra.lfoWaveforms: Seamless morph from triangle (soft) to square (hard/chop)
extra.powerInputRating: Standard 9 V DC, center negative, >100 mA
extra.retailerAvailability: Thomann lists the model as available since April 2018
extra.dimensions: 58 x 74 x 132 mm (H x W x D)
extra.imageProcessing: Official top-down has a bottom drop shadow/reflection. It was removed (alpha threshold before trimming) so the shadow is not part of the hosted cutout or the 7.4 x 13.2 cm footprint. Hosted as AVIF q80 (800/350) for storage/bandwidth; PSNR 42.4 dB vs the approved PNG cutout.
extra.jackPositions: Official rear view labels INPUT at panel-left, 9V DC center, OUTPUT at panel-right; mirrored to the top-down player view gives OUTPUT ~0.2, 9V ~0.5, INPUT ~0.8. Normalized estimates from the official rear/top images, not measured cm.
